policy.scope: exploratory single-fit train/development pilot; no test access
policy.mmd: biased linear MMD squared on 421 frozen features; valid canonical 1..48 only
policy.feature_blocks: length/48,20 AA fractions,400 dipeptide fractions; each scaled by 1/sqrt(3)
policy.reconstruction: posterior mean only; rendered sequence aligned to target positions; no nearest-neighbor truth
policy.macro: mean recall over amino-acid classes supported by target; PAD excluded
policy.missing_prediction: counts incorrect at every unrendered target position; never removes truth denominator
policy.ar_nll: teacher-forced diagnostic reported separately; not comparable with VAE objective
policy.uncertainty: no p-values/CI; draws are not independent training replicates; development has been reused
policy.claims: no activity, wetlab validation, significance, novelty, general method superiority or submission-readiness claim
policy.engineering_prerequisite: screens require complete request execution here and independently verified fixed-step training/budget upstream
